policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Millersville have scored more than any other programme while conceding three goals in six matches, as few as any side has let in; the scoring and the meanest defence sit at the same end of the chart.
Pitt-Johnstown have conceded fourteen goals, more than any other programme has let in, and have lost three of their four matches.
Lock Haven have drawn three and lost two of their five matches without a win, and their nine goals have come from seven different players.
